verdict.rationale: Baseten publishes the source of Truss, its own model-packaging and deployment tool, in a public GitHub repository (basetenlabs/truss). That gives users readable source for part of the product. The hosted platform itself (Model APIs, MCM orchestration, training infrastructure) shows no source availability, and the evidence never states the license Truss is released under. missing for 10: evidence of an explicit open-source license, source for the core hosted platform, independent corroboration of openness.
